instruction: Look at gui_019_cover_with_bosses.step in SolidWorks, a thin cover of size 120 x 90 x 5 mm from Z=0 to Z=5 with R8 outside corners and four top cylindrical bosses of diameter 10 mm and height 10 mm at (X,Y)=(-40,-25), (-40,25), (40,-25), and (40,25). Convert each boss into a screw post by cutting a 3.4 mm diameter through hole through the boss and the cover. Add four reinforcing ribs between adjacent bosses. The two horizontal ribs are 4 mm wide in Y, 6 mm high from Z=5 to Z=11, and span X=-36..36 at Y=+25 and Y=-25. The two vertical ribs are 4 mm wide in X, 6 mm high from Z=5 to Z=11, and span Y=-21..21 at X=+40 and X=-40. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_019_cover_boss_ribs_out.step.
